bandsNote: drafted 2026-10-12 by scripts/bands.mjs off the released default page (/): each kept band that is not a picture wears the system's ground (src/bands.mjs), its words keep their colours; 14/10/2026 (visual review: the header’s menu and phone number near black on its blue bar, 1.8–2.1:1, every system, home and inner pages): the header (#t4-header, T4’s .t4-palette-secondary #30408d) was a picture band only because of a faint repeated pattern (a small data-URI PNG) over its flat ground, so its ground stayed the template blue while its accent paints were judged on a photo assumed lighter and came out near black; and its paint named every .menu-item-title, the dropdowns’ too, where the template paints only the active link orange. It is a worn band now (picture: false): it wears the system’s accent where the template’s white words read on it, else its ink, the pattern still over it; the active level-0 link (li.active > a.nav-link) and the phone number take the accent made readable on that ground, the other links keep their white, the dropdown panels their own words, and its call to action the band’s pair; 17/10/2026 (Akemi's review under Mailchimp: the home page's About, Ready to rest, We Value Relationships and footer-wave bands stayed the template's blue #30408d under every system, the accent-leak finder named them with the slideshow dots, arrows and tagline): .t4-section-1/6/9/10 are T4's .t4-palette-secondary over the same faint data-URI pattern as the header and were drafted as picture bands, so the keep scope reset every role inside them and the template's own palette rule (--vds-pal-bg: ink, on-ink words, the wave ::after reading --vds-pal-bg) fell back to the blue. They are no longer kept: the template's palette wears the system's ink with on-ink words. The slideshow stays a band (its photo slides) worn as ink, its tagline, title-link hover, active dot, dot and arrow hovers take the accent made readable on that ground (they read --ds-c-accent, reset inside the band). The header's top-level hover and open links take the same accent as its active link (they read the palette hover, which was white then the dull accent-on-ink)

containerGutterNote: 14/10/2026 (visual review): a row of the destinations band (div.row, its negative gutters and arrows) hangs 45px off the container's edge; under Notion and Apple it was cut at the window's edge. The container keeps 64px from the window's edges instead of 32.
hoverNote: 21/10/2026 (HOVER-2, TEXT-1 batch 3): article titles, 'Read More' and tag links read one role at rest and on hover under some systems (Moxie, 5fd3), so hover and focus also underline; buttons, dropdown items, the logo and pagination keep their own states. The header menu's caret icon kept the template's own orange #f68c05 (ACCENT-LEAK): the band paints its colour with the system's accent fill, as it does the caret's triangle. The same underline is written on the link's inner words (span, strong, em, b, small, headings, p): the probe reads the cue on the element that holds the words, and an underline set on the link alone does not change that element's computed style.
